notes: Add more than one Telegram account and switch between them, each with its own library, history and settings, and an optional PIN for a profile. A Downloads tab on phone, TV and desktop: one list, a storage page, and a question before a running download is cancelled. Search shows what it is doing at every step, has one clear button everywhere, and a result with progress has a Resume button. The player's Episodes list is a sheet on a phone and a panel on a TV and desktop, with 16:9 pictures and a Next up card that no longer grabs the remote. Holding an arrow to seek on a TV is paced and grows in steps, and the speed button shows the speed. TV: one focus ring per control, a larger Home hero, and the account menu opens as a side sheet. Phone: a fixed top bar on Settings, About and Downloads, a more compact bottom bar, and text that stays whole at a large font. One name for the sync switch everywhere: Sync across my devices. Home no longer says Get your first video while a slow account is still loading. Videos start faster on low-end devices, where decoding now uses half the cores.
